title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Blueberry Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Edition Pre Filled Pods for the Elf Bar Dual 10K deliver a berry-filled combo with punch and depth. One pod combines sweet Blueberry with a tangy twist of Sour Raspberry for a bright, tart edge. The second pod keeps things simple and smooth with classic Blueberry - a soft, juicy vape with rich undertones. Each 2ml pod is connected to a built-in 5ml refill reservoir, topped up automatically by the Dual 10K internal system. If you're a fan of berry flavours with contrast and clarity, Blueberry Edition delivers a double hit worth exploring. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
